assertion_analysis: Real-home isolation assertion fails if these cases create/remove either tracked real-home path.
Live-pid control fails unless the fixture really presents a live local process, making the foreign-pid collision meaningful.
Retained-session assertion fails if resume drops or replaces the fixture session.
Worktree identity assertion fails if resume builds its launch for a different directory; this is a real output comparison, with no mocked identity-returning owner.
Attempt assertion fails if preparing the resumed attempt does not persist attempt 2.

Host assertion fails if the persisted observation names a host other than the pointer launch host; the expected host is fixture input, while the actual value is independently read from production-written disk.
Empty-output assertion fails if the successful vacant scheduler answer is not preserved as the empty string.
Gone assertion fails if successful vacancy is not classified as gone.
Timestamp assertion fails if the persisted observation carries no observation time.
Node-query assertion fails if the production code never invokes the stand-in scontrol.
User-query assertion fails if no squeue call includes this account uid.
Explicit pytest.fail fires if either signal entry point is reached for the foreign pid.
Stop result assertion fails if the foreign attempt exit cannot be recorded.
Empty ended-pids assertion fails if stop claims local processes were signalled.
Receipt run identity assertion fails if stop writes a receipt for another run.
Recorder assertion fails unless the exit is durably attributed to crew-stop.
Receipt observation assertion fails if the stop receipt omits or contradicts scheduler proof.
Pointer observation assertion fails if the successful empty answer is not copied onto the durable run pointer.
No-exit assertion fails if an unresolved host is nevertheless recorded stopped.
Unknown-liveness assertion fails if an occupied, login or unreadable host is reported known alive or dead.
False-gone assertion fails if any unresolved host is marked process_gone.
Occupied-output control fails if the instrument cannot see the known running job or discards its answer.
Failed/login-output assertion fails if no-query/failure is collapsed to an empty successful answer.
Scheduler-call-file assertion fails if the code never invokes a scheduler query.
Each pytest.raises at the end of the file fails if resume_plan, attempt preparation or terminate accepts an occupied/login/failed-query host.
assertion_independence: Fixture-input comparisons at session/worktree/host/receipt identity check real production outputs or persisted files; none compares two aliases of one mocked value and none remains true whatever production does. Reinstating the base modules refuses vacancy before these assertions, as the recorded negative control demonstrates. Individual assertions additionally protect evidence fields, identity and signal exclusion as described.
